fields.label: Chassis manufacturer
fields.source: Hackney final work order, p. 1, dated 08/26/2020; Freightliner door-jamb component label (IMG_0335 / IMG_0339).

fields.label: Chassis model / model year
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 1 explicitly specifies “FREIGHTLINER M2-112” and “2021 MODEL YEAR SPECIFIED” (IMG_0339).

fields.label: Trailer manufacturer / year
fields.source: Apparatus details supplied by user; manufacturer plate not independently reviewed.

fields.label: Cab configuration
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 1: two-door M2-112; in-cab vehicle placard: designed to carry max. two personnel (IMG_0338). Low-roof configuration per owner and vehicle photos.

fields.label: Tractor axle configuration
fields.value: Two axles: front steer axle and single rear drive axle
fields.source: Hackney final work order pp. 1 and 4 (IMG_0339 and IMG_0342).

fields.label: Trailer body type
fields.value: Custom side-load technical rescue / collapse semi-trailer
fields.source: User-supplied description; SMFR Fleet Friday (October 22, 2021) confirms custom Hackney trailer.

fields.label: Trailer serial number
fields.source: Trailer serial number not established by supplied documents; 20F09571 is labeled as a Hackney job/order number, not a confirmed serial number.

fields.label: Trailer side doors
fields.source: User-supplied door count and existing labelled compartment map L1–L9 / R1–R9.

fields.label: Trailer rear access
fields.source: Supplied rear compartment photograph.

fields.label: Trailer axle configuration
fields.source: Visible in supplied apparatus photographs; also described in Firehouse coverage of SMFR technical rescue.

fields.label: Trailer build / job reference (reported)
fields.value: Hackney job/order no. 20F09571; body code TU100
fields.source: Hackney final work order, p. 1 (IMG_0339); replaces earlier unsupported TU1982 report.

fields.label: Overall length (coupled)
fields.source: In-cab vehicle height/length/GVWR placard (IMG_0338). Operational clearance should be remeasured if the vehicle configuration has changed.

fields.label: Overall height (maximum travel height)
fields.source: In-cab vehicle height/length/GVWR placard (IMG_0338). Label instructs owner to revise for changes; verify current height before clearance decisions.

fields.label: Tractor wheelbase
fields.source: Hackney final work order, p. 5: wheelbase 3800 mm / 150 in (IMG_0343).

fields.label: Tractor GVWR
fields.source: In-cab placard (IMG_0338) and Hackney final work order p. 1 (IMG_0339).

fields.label: Trailer GVWR
fields.source: User-supplied rating. Confirm lb or kg on the certification label before using.

fields.label: GCWR
fields.source: Build order p. 1 states 80,000 lb EXPECTED gross combination weight, not a verified rated GCWR. Do not use as certified GCWR without chassis documentation.

fields.label: Tractor front GAWR
fields.source: Freightliner door-jamb component rating label and Hackney build order pp. 1, 3 (IMG_0335, IMG_0339, IMG_0341); verify on vehicle certification label for formal GAWR.

fields.label: Tractor rear GAWR
fields.source: Freightliner door-jamb component rating label and Hackney build order pp. 1, 4 (IMG_0335, IMG_0339, IMG_0342); verify on vehicle certification label for formal GAWR.

fields.label: Engine make / model
fields.source: Hackney final work order pp. 1–2: “Cummins ISL-400” and “CUM L9 400EV” (IMG_0339 and IMG_0340).

fields.label: Engine rated horsepower
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 2 (IMG_0340).

fields.label: Transmission
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 3 (IMG_0341).

fields.label: Fuel type / tank capacity
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 5 lists a 60-gallon LH aluminum fuel tank (IMG_0343). Diesel confirmed in engine and aftertreatment specifications.

fields.label: DEF capacity (if equipped)
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 3 specifies a 6-gallon diesel exhaust fluid tank (IMG_0341).

fields.label: Tire sizes / cold inflation specifications
fields.value: Front and rear: 11R22.5, 14-ply; cold inflation not provided
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 5: Michelin XZE2 front, Michelin X Multi Energy D rear (IMG_0343). Obtain tire-pressure placard before use.

fields.label: Trailer coupling / kingpin specification
fields.value: Holland FW31 fifth wheel; kingpin size not confirmed
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 5 identifies Holland FW31 with 7-in fifth-wheel height (IMG_0343); kingpin size not stated.

fields.label: Engine rated torque
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 2 (IMG_0340).

fields.label: Brake system / ABS specification
fields.value: Air brakes; WABCO 4S/4M ABS with traction control
fields.source: Hackney final work order pp. 3–4 describes air brake package, drum foundation brakes and WABCO 4S/4M ABS (IMG_0341 and IMG_0342).

fields.label: Tractor suspension
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 4 (IMG_0342).

groups.title: Freightliner M2-112 model reference — NOT unit-specific ratings

fields.label: Model identification status
fields.value: 2021 Freightliner M2-112 confirmed in unit-specific build order.
fields.source: Hackney final work order p. 1 (IMG_0339).

fields.label: M2 112 day cab — BBC dimension
fields.source: Freightliner M2 112 brochure. Model-family reference; not a verified measurement of Unit 3306.

fields.label: M2 112 — period engine options
fields.value: Installed engine per build order: Cummins L9 / ISL-400
fields.source: Hackney final work order pp. 1–2 (IMG_0339 and IMG_0340). Replaces generic engine-option reference.

fields.label: GVWR and GCWR caution
fields.value: Tractor GVWR confirmed at 35,000 lb. GCWR not yet verified; do not add GVWR ratings to derive GCWR.
fields.source: In-cab placard (IMG_0338); Hackney build order p. 1 mentions expected gross combination weight but no independently verified certification rating.
